## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!` / `fix!` / `BREAKING CHANGE:`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)

- [ ] Example under `modules/<module>/examples/` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Ran `tofu fmt -recursive` and `tofu validate` locally
